about_the_game:
ICHORLESS is an RPG where you play as a modern-day human, mysteriously pulled into ancient Greece to fulfill a prophecy that’s supposed to save the gods! 

On your journey home, you’ll face Gods,  Demigods, Monsters, Mortals, and Titans in a mythic world overflowing with danger, drama, and just a bit of absurdity!

Defeat, or gain the favor of a god to earn their Blessing!—unique powers that completely change how you battle the next divine challenger.

Got Apollo’s Blessing? Great! If you want, you can turn every single boss fight into a singing showdown. Prefer puzzles? Survival challenges? Bullet-hell shooting? Classic turn-based strategy? Fighting games?

You decide how to enjoy this adventure!

Your choices shape not just your gaming experience… but the fate of Greece itself!

Featuring:

- An Original, Fully-Composed Soundtrack to immerse you in the adventure.

- Innovative Battle Mechanics that keep every encounter fresh and strategic.

- Branching Storylines with Over 50 Unique Endings shaped entirely by your choices.

- Witty Humor and Clever Nods to Mythology for fans of legendary tales.

-  20+ Reason Battles —master all and forge your own path!

- And Countless Surprises waiting to be discovered!

WISHLIST THE GAME!

[Trailer + Demo + Kickstarter Launching Soon!]
